title: Foggy Lower Manhattan Skyline Across Harbor, 1956 NYC B&W Snapshot Photo
location: New York City, New York, United States
description: A panoramic black and white snapshot photograph taken across New York Harbor in June 1956, showcasing the Lower Manhattan skyline veiled in a thick, atmospheric layer of fog and mist. Distinct skyscraper silhouettes rise against the overcast sky, with several tugs, barges, and small vessels cruising along the calm harbor waters in the foreground. The print features a deckled edge with the photofinisher date stamp 'JUN 56' on the top margin.
